{{Quote|Those Vulkars are dumber than a Coruscant granite slug!|[[Canderous Ordo]] referring to the [[Black Vulkars/Legends|Black Vulkars]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''granite slug''' was a [[Silica parasite/Legends|silica parasite]] native to the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that left a corrosive acidic slime wherever it travelled. They were preyed upon by [[Hawk-bat/Legends|Hawk-bats]].<ref name="Wildlife" />

==History==
[[Granite/Legends|Granite]] slugs were introduced to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]] in [[335 BBY]] in an attempt by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to clean up the profuse amount of garbage that existed there. The large amount of food materials resulted in a rapid growth in granite slug population, which resulted in increased "cleanliness" in the city, but also resulted in a population increase among the predator populations as well.<ref name="JAS">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref>
